name: CTL Dash
blurb: CTL Dash is a systemd service manager for the COSMIC desktop environment that displays system and user services with their status.
description:
CTL Dash is a systemd service manager for the COSMIC desktop environment that displays system and user services with their status.

Features:

• View all systemd services with their current status

• Manage both system-wide and user services

• View detailed information about individual services

• Start, stop, restart services from the UI

• Enable and disable services

• View service logs

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
